description: This file defines the route component for creating a new note in a Remix-based React application. It includes data loading, form handling, and rendering of the 'Create Note' page.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Provides metadata for the page, setting the page title.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches default data for the note creation form, currently empty strings.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission, creates a new note, and redirects to its page.

methods.name: NewNote
methods.description: React component rendering the note creation form with input fields and submit button.
